about.description: Fortunafi is a New York-based RWA platform providing tokenized US T-bill exposure to institutional crypto investors. The ifBILL fund (Fortunafi Tokenized Short-Term U.S. Bonds) is a Cayman-domiciled feeder fund whose tokens are issued on the Canton Network (operated by Digital Asset). Fortunafi previously operated tokenized private credit products and pivoted toward tokenized US Treasuries as the institutional-grade DeFi market matured. The Canton issuance is notable as one of the first major productional uses of Canton for RWA tokenization, leveraging Canton's privacy and atomic-settlement features for institutional fund administration.
about.registryInfo: Fortunafi Asset Management Inc. is the SEC-registered investment adviser (CRD 305849) managing Fortunafi-branded tokenized funds, including ifBILL (the Fortunafi Tokenized Short-Term U.S. Bonds fund). Fund vehicle: Fortunafi Capital International LP, a Cayman Islands exempted limited partnership. Founders: Jonas Lamis and the Fortunafi team. Headquartered in New York. ifBILL was issued on the Canton Network in partnership with Digital Asset (the Canton-network operator) and Broadridge.

fees.revenueNotes: ifBILL management fee estimated at ~30 bps based on Cayman-feeder tokenized T-bill fund norms; actual fee disclosed in the fund's offering memorandum to qualified investors only. Not independently verified.
